draft.name: PDP page comparison with comparable product detail
draft.persona: Fashion Aspirer: a highly fashion-engaged shopper who cares about personal style and trends, finds inspiration in everyday life and culture, and shops across brands and channels. They engage directly with fashion brands through social media and websites, and look for inspiring, creative fashion that fits their style. Based on the 2023 US Fashion Aspirer survey; adapt for the market and experiment.
draft.task: Find and add the T-shirt to the shopping bag.
draft.successEvent: Select the Add to bag or Add button.

pilotRuns.profile: Age 18–24; man; location urban US; experienced online shopper; scans before deciding; prioritises price; moderately patient; looks for the most direct next action. Trend-led shopper scans for price first, then takes the most direct route to add a T-shirt to the bag, balancing style appeal with cost and moderate patience.

outcome.reason: Direct action to add the T-shirt to the bag, fulfilling the goal after scanning price context.

pilotRuns.profile: Age 18–24; man; location urban US; experienced online shopper; scans before deciding; prioritises price; moderately patient; looks for the most direct next action. pilotRuns.profile: Age 18–24; man; location urban US; frequent fashion shopper; compares multiple products; prioritises price; focused and methodical; checks fit and sizing information before deciding. Style-driven frequent shopper methodically compares several T-shirts, checks fit and sizing, weighs price against aesthetic, then prepares to add the chosen item to the bag.

outcome.reason: User inspects the product image and reads visible fit/price details before interacting.

pilotRuns.profile: Age 55–64; woman; location urban US; occasional fashion shopper; scans before deciding; balances price and style; moderately patient; looks for price or delivery information before committing. Occasional style-focused shopper scans before deciding, balancing trend fit with price and delivery details; moderately patient, seeks inspiration across brands weighing whether to add a T-shirt

outcome.reason: The user scans the promotional offer for price details and the product image for style, then commits by clicking the clear call-to-action to add the item.

outcome.reason: Prominent high-contrast 'ADD TO BAG' button aligns with the user's goal of quick, convenient task completion.

pilotRuns.profile: Age 45–54; man; location urban Sweden; experienced online shopper; shops with a specific item in mind; prioritises visual style; easily distracted; is cautious about ambiguous controls and may hesitate.
